docs.description: [to be translated]:OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Gemini-compatible HTTP API for Cherry Studio, plus Cherry-specific endpoints (models, knowledge bases)

operations.chat_completions: [to be translated]:Create a chat completion. Request and response bodies follow the OpenAI Chat Completions format; set `stream: true` for incremental output.
operations.count_tokens: [to be translated]:Estimate how many input tokens a set of Anthropic-format messages uses.
operations.generate_content: [to be translated]:Generate content through Gemini's `generateContent` method. Request and response bodies follow the Gemini API format; `streamGenerateContent` is served on the same path.
operations.get_knowledge_base: [to be translated]:Fetch a single knowledge base by ID.
operations.health: [to be translated]:Service health, current time and version. No authentication required.
operations.info: [to be translated]:API name, version and the main endpoints. No authentication required.
operations.list_knowledge_bases: [to be translated]:List the knowledge bases available in this Cherry Studio instance.
operations.list_models: [to be translated]:List the models available through this gateway, in the OpenAI models format.
operations.messages: [to be translated]:Create a message. Request and response bodies follow the Anthropic Messages format; set `stream: true` for incremental output.
operations.responses: [to be translated]:Create a response. Request and response bodies follow the OpenAI Responses format.
operations.search_knowledge_bases: [to be translated]:Search one or more knowledge bases and return the matching document chunks.

tags.anthropic: [to be translated]:Anthropic-compatible endpoints. Point an Anthropic SDK at this gateway's base URL to use them.
tags.cherry: [to be translated]:Cherry Studio's own endpoints: knowledge bases, service info and health check.
tags.gemini: [to be translated]:Gemini-compatible endpoints, served under `/v1beta` like the upstream API.
tags.openai: [to be translated]:OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Point an OpenAI SDK at this gateway's base URL to use them.

errors.preflight_failed: [to be translated]:Cherry Studio could not validate the OpenClaw configuration.
